title: Get three crypto accounts to quote the launch
task: Tranquilo, nothing fancy. Find three real crypto accounts on X, each over 10k followers, and get them to quote-post our launch with their own honest take. No bought engagement, no bots. Real people who actually post.
deliverables: Links to all three quote-posts
Screenshot of each account's follower count (10k+)
Posts still live and public 48 hours after submission

title: Build an open-source pump.fun GO scraper
task: A clean, public tool that pulls the live bounty board into structured JSON. Title, reward, deadline, link, per bounty. MIT licensed so anyone can use it. Make it something you would actually run yourself.
deliverables: Public GitHub repo, MIT license, README with run instructions
Sample output: a JSON file of 50 current bounties
Two-minute screen recording of it running end to end

title: Make a ten-second meme that actually lands
task: One short video, ten seconds or less, that makes people laugh and want to share. Original work, not a reupload. Bueno, if it is not funny, it does not count. Make me smile first.
deliverables: The original video file
Link to it posted on X or TikTok
Timestamped screenshot showing 5,000+ views

title: Design a free bounty card UI kit
task: A small, clean card system anyone can drop into a project. Four states: fresh, posted, claimed, expired. Give it away free so the whole board looks better, not just ours.
deliverables: Public Figma file link with all four card states
Exported PNG previews of each state
A note granting free use (CC0 or similar)

title: Map every live GO bounty over $500
task: Go through the board and list every active bounty paying more than 500 dollars. Honest work, no guessing. If the reward is unclear, leave it out.
deliverables: A spreadsheet with columns: title, reward, deadline, link
At least 20 rows, each with a working link
Timestamp showing when you pulled the data

title: Fifty keepie-uppies, one unbroken take
task: Film yourself doing fifty keepie-uppies without the ball touching the ground, one continuous shot, somewhere safe and legal. Daylight, count out loud or on screen. Dale, it is harder than it looks.
deliverables: One unedited phone video, no cuts
The count clearly visible or audible through all fifty
Posted publicly with a caption, link included

title: Translate the board into Spanish and Portuguese
task: Take the current bounty board copy and translate it into natural Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese. Native quality, not machine. The kind a friend would write, not a manual.
deliverables: Two text files: es and pt-BR
A side-by-side document, English next to each translation
Your name or handle so we can credit you

title: Explain GO escrow in 600 plain words
task: Write 600 words a newcomer can actually follow on how pump.fun GO escrow works. How the reward is locked, how proof gets verified, who decides payout. Plain and honest, no hype.
deliverables: Public Google Doc link, around 600 words
Every claim backed by a linked source
No filler, no marketing voice
